implications_for_desk: Cash spikes far above the [3,15]% policy band are a RECURRING structural feature of this book, not a fresh defect to re-flag each run.
Every redeployment proposal must be sized for stop-out probability, preferring lower-vol mega-caps over high-beta pure-plays when filling cluster gaps.
Deployments should be staged in tranches around known binary events (FOMC, earnings), never in one shot.
Recommend stop distances near 2x the name's recent daily range; stops at the prior day's low on 7-9% daily-range names are near-certain whipsaws.

STANDING TENSION: the draft policy's cluster targets (Optics 20%, Power 15%, Memory 20%) force exposure to the highest-volatility parts of the AI-capex chain -- exactly what keeps stopping out. Fully curing a cash breach within the current bands REQUIRES buying the volatile clusters. Flag for user decision.
